hub.title: Peer-to-peer webtools on nostr.
hub.lead: Every tool here runs entirely in your browser and syncs over relays you choose.
hub.accountText: One account for every tool here. Your boards, files and chats follow you to every device you sign in on; without an account they stay on this device.
hub.accountSigned: Every tool here uses this account. Boards you made on this device before signing in are carried over.
hub.relaysText: The tools here sync over these nostr relays; pick your own in the settings. Relays pass data along; they can’t read anything that was encrypted first.
settings.title: Settings
settings.deviceText: Chosen here, used by every tool. With an account they follow you to your other devices.
settings.appsText: Hide the tools you don’t use; they disappear from the start page on every device signed in as you.
settings.backupText: One file with your key and everything your devices know: boards, settings, your account. Encrypted with a passphrase, it restores everything even if every relay forgot you.
settings.deviceCardText: Wiping removes your key and all cached data from this browser. Without an account, an exported key or a backup, whatever only this device had is lost.
settings.wipeConfirm: Delete this device’s key and all cached data?
settings.blockedText: People on this list can’t message you, can’t add you as a friend, and their posts stay out of your feeds. The list is encrypted; only your devices can read it.
settings.blockAdd: Block someone by their public key
settings.blockInvalid: That is not a public key (npub1… or 64 hex characters).
hub.cta: Everything you make here lives under a key that exists only in this browser. Create an account or sign in to use your boards, files and chats on every device.
settings.powText: Some tools ask this device for a moment of computing before publishing, to keep spam out. More cores finish faster; this device has {n}.
settings.peopleText: Friends are mutual: you ask, they accept, and each of you keeps the other. From any tool you can then send boards, files or posts to friends or to a circle. The lists are encrypted; relays can’t see who is friends with whom.
settings.yourKey: Your key, for people who want to add you:
settings.friendAdd: Add a friend by their public key
settings.noFriends: No friends yet. Send someone your key, or add theirs.
settings.circlesText: Groups of friends, to send something to several people at once. Only you see your circles.
settings.circleEmpty: Add friends first; then tick who belongs to this circle.
